description:
Give the human operator immediate, low-noise visibility into active minions through a persistent pi-native widget, backed by the runtime-derived activity model.

## Background

The current footer/status shows only running counts and rotating command hints. Detailed activity requires opening `/minions`, which is an interactive drill-down rather than ambient visibility. Pi supports persistent widgets above/below the editor; this is the least disruptive surface for a fleet summary.

## UX contract

While any spawn or orchestrated child is pending/running, render a compact fleet widget above the editor:

```text
3 active · group grp-1234
otto  implementation       Add auth guard       → npm test
mel   reviewImplementation Review auth commit   reading src/auth.ts
lola  investigateBlocker   Trace retry failure  waiting on parent
```

Exact typography may vary, but preserve:

- active count and open group identity when relevant
- one concise row per visible child: minion name, agent/taskType where space allows, fleet description/task summary, current trusted activity
- pending vs running vs waiting/settling must be distinguishable
- fixed modest visible-row cap with `+N more`; no new configuration knob initially
- clear widget automatically when no children are active
- keep `/minions` and `/minions show` as interactive detail/cycling surfaces

## Pi TUI requirements

- Use `ctx.ui.setWidget()`; do not replace the footer and do not open/focus an overlay.
- Implement a real component whose `render(width)` uses the supplied width. Do not use `process.stdout.columns` as component width.
- Every line must obey width using ANSI-aware `truncateToWidth`/`visibleWidth`.
- State changes invalidate and request render through the injected TUI.
- Theme invalidation must rebuild any pre-themed cached content so theme switches do not preserve stale ANSI colors.
- Subscribe/unsubscribe cleanly across session replacement/shutdown; never retain stale contexts or widget references.
- Render trusted activity summaries, not unsanitized streamed child prose.

## Scope / likely files

- new focused fleet-widget component/module under `packages/pi-minions/src/subsessions/` or `src/tui/`
- status/observability integration and session lifecycle wiring
- retain existing per-minion observability drill-down; refactor shared formatting only when it strictly reduces duplication
- component/unit/integration tests

## Acceptance behavior

- Pending/running children appear without the operator issuing `/minions`.
- Activity changes update the existing widget without transcript spam or focus capture.
- Narrow terminals truncate safely; wide terminals show useful agent/task/description context.
- More children than the cap produce `+N more` deterministically.
- Widget disappears after the final active child terminates.
- `/new`, resume, fork, reload, and shutdown dispose subscriptions and do not update stale UI.
- Footer token/cost and existing extension status behavior remain intact.

## Do not

- Add periodic parent-model messages.
- Add a Beadwork fleet UI or import AgentTree into Beadwork.
- Add display settings until dogfood demonstrates a concrete need.
- Replace the `/minions` drill-down.

## Tests and validation

Add component rendering tests for widths/themes/caps/states, reactive tree-update tests, and session lifecycle cleanup tests. Run pi-minions lint/test/typecheck plus a documented manual TUI smoke. Commit atomically with this issue id.

comments.text: Implementation landed at 71b5e645d8ddef640f1aa41832865c57a8a043cf. Files: new fleet-widget.ts, focused fleet-widget.test.ts, index.ts lifecycle wiring. Implementer reports pi-minions lint/typecheck/build pass, 23 files/277 tests, 13 focused fleet tests, clean diff/checkout. Interactive TUI smoke explicitly not claimed and remains required. Parent inspection confirms setWidget aboveEditor, supplied-width ANSI-aware rendering, one AgentTree subscription/controller, terminal clear, and session-owned destroy wiring; independent source/API review required before acceptance.

Independent review 07e2b111 FAIL at 71b5e645. Parent disposition: FIX all four findings. Blocking: (1) sanitizeActivityText UTF-16 slicing can create orphan surrogates and post-UTF8 width overflow; truncate at grapheme boundaries and test emoji/ZWJ/combining + round-trip width. (2) Unterminated OSC/APC/DCS terminal-string payloads survive as visible hostile identity; strip string-command payload through terminator or EOS and test terminated/unterminated BEL/ST forms. (3) fitEnds one-column ellipsis budget removes identity at widths 4–7; preserve at least first identity grapheme and assert useful narrow output. (4) Lifecycle parameterization is cosmetic; acceptance explicitly requires /new/resume/fork/reload/shutdown cleanup, so replace/collapse fake direct-destroy cases and add real emitted lifecycle/non-TUI/stale-transition regressions. Source/API, theme, footer/status, packet/group, reactive and main lifecycle design otherwise passed. Manual real TUI smoke remains a separate closure gate after fixes.

Review fixes landed at final superseding SHA d7f2acc517d77a6e6cb8724605fa20ab15bfc8bb (all prior 2ff95ab references superseded/invalid). Four scoped files: activity sanitizer + tests, fleet widget + tests. Reported: grapheme-safe Intl.Segmenter truncation with hostile surrogate replacement; complete ESC/C1 terminal string stripping through terminator/EOS; useful identity retained widths 4–7; production-shaped lifecycle sequences including TUI→RPC. Validation: 23/313 package, focused 5/142, lint/typecheck/build/diff/status clean. Manual TUI smoke not claimed. Independent re-review required.

title: Add a persistent compact fleet progress widget
